name: WayriCAD Assistant
description: Run reviewed KiCad checks and interpret reports with optional local Ollama.
description_full: Use local commands or optional loopback Ollama for registered WayriCAD actions: fitted BOM counts, saved copper areas, thermal screening, and supported PI, SI and EMerge workflows. Review editable plans and supply missing inputs or study files before explicitly running Ollama proposals. Explanations cite hash-verified results, not engineering sign-off. No cloud model, automatic model download or layout edit. Solver dependencies still apply. KiCad 10 testing package.
